cause_quote: The commit introduced profile selection with `await readText(path.join(root, "active_profile"))` and memory deduplication with `await fs.readFile(item.target, "utf8").catch(() => "")`, both of which can block on a named pipe with no writer.
user_saw: Hermes migration preview or import hung when a configuration file, the active profile selector, or an existing memory target was a named pipe with no writer.
summary: Hermes migration now uses a regular-file reader for text inputs and memory deduplication so named pipes are rejected without blocking.
reasoning: The introducing diff and its parent show that active profile discovery and memory deduplication shipped with blocking reads and no regular-file check. The configuration read already had the same flaw at the shallow boundary, and the available offline history did not establish its introducing commit.
